walls.notes: Modern block (BrewDog bar; CAU restaurant in older photos). Black-framed full-height glazing on the ground floor, recessed behind a round black column. A white rendered box projects above it with a wide black-framed window, plus a dark brick bay toward the west next to the railed yard (red-brick piers and an iron gate). In reality the block rises to about 3 storeys. The OSM eave height of 5.3 m covers only the ground floor and the first band, so I annotated only that. The shop name follows the most recent photos (BrewDog signs); the older 465114114745032 / 465922964705436 show CAU.
